Hence recover squared side lengths as roots z²−Sz+P and |C|=sqrt(Z), with positive-definite Gram conditions including squares and rectangles. Explicit positive-definite Gram matrices G1=[[1,1/2],[1/2,1]], G2=[[5/4,sqrt(33/160)],[sqrt(33/160),3/4]] share m1=1/3,m2=13/60 but m3=43/210 versus 1133/5600.
